title: 第1926章 再见洛如画超时空秘境的由来第1925章 李云天也要疯了洛如画来消息
slug: 被问罪当天无上帝族杀来
content_zh:
念及此，陈稳直接往其中注入灵力。
“洛前辈。”
还不待洛如画开口，陈稳直接道。
洛如画应声道“还记得我与你的约定吧。”
“当然，我一直在等您的消息呢。”
陈稳立时笑道。
洛如画点了点头，“你现在在哪。”
“我还在登天商会。”陈稳开口道。
“等我过去。”
说着，洛如画的话锋一转，“让温族那丫头帮忙准备一下前往第九领地的传送阵。”
陈稳猛然一震，“好，我这就跟她说。”
“嗯，就先这样，我明天就可以到你那。”
洛如画丢下一句话后，便直接断开了联系。
陈稳轻吐了一口浊气，转而又联系起温弦乐来。
不多时，温弦乐的声音从传音令中传出，“是住的地方不合适吗？”
陈稳摇了摇头，“很合适，就是突发了一情况，想让你帮个忙。”
温弦乐沉默了一下，才道：“先说说看。”
陈稳立时开口道：“是这样的，我想去第九领地一趟，所以想让你帮忙准备一下传送阵。”
“对了，我还有一个朋友和我一起过去，不知道这会不会打扰。”
第九领地？

朋友？
温弦乐的眼底一闪，但并没有追问，“这是小事，我可以帮你安排，说个时间吧。”
“明天吧。”
陈稳想了想，才道。
对于他来说，洛如画明天才到，具体时间是不确定的。
而准备好明天的传送阵，完全是有备无患，也能赶得上。
“好，我这就去安排。”
温弦乐丢下一句话后，便断开了联系。
陈稳的嘴角微微一勾，还真的是有熟人好办事。
不可否认的是，温弦乐帮了他很多忙。
做完这一切，陈稳也没有浪费时间，立时进入了修炼状态。
转眼一天过去。
陈稳从修炼中醒了过来，随即轻吐了一口浊气。
外面一天的时间，永恒空间就是八天。
他剩用这八天的时间来凝炼意志种子了。
content_en:
Thinking of this, Chen Wen directly injected spiritual power into it.
"Senior Luo."
Before Luo Ruhua could speak, Chen Wen said directly.
Luo Ruhua responded, "Remember the agreement I made with you."
"Of course, I've been waiting for news from you."
Chen Wen immediately smiled.
Luo Ruhua nodded, "Where are you now."
"I'm still in Dengtian Chamber of Commerce." Chen Wen said.
"Wait until I get there."
With that said, Luo Ruhua changed the topic, "Let that girl from the Wen tribe help prepare the teleportation array to the ninth territory."
Chen Wen was shocked and said, "Okay, I'll tell her right now."
"Well, that's it for now. I can come to your place tomorrow."
After Luo Ruhua said a word, she immediately disconnected.
Chen Wen took out a breath and contacted Wen Xingxuan again.
Not long after, Wen Xingxing's voice came from the transmission command, "Is the place where you live inappropriate?"
Chen Wen shook his head, "It's very appropriate. I just have an unexpected situation and I want you to help me."
Wen Xingxuan was silent for a moment and then said, "Let's talk about it first."
Chen Wen immediately said: "That's it, I want to go to the ninth territory, so I want you to help prepare the teleportation array."
"By the way, I have a friend going there with me. I don't know if this will disturb me."
The ninth territory?
friend?
Wen Xingxuan's eyes flashed, but he didn't ask further, "It's a small matter. I can help you arrange it. Let's tell you a time."
"Tomorrow."
Chen Wen thought for a while before saying.
For him, Luo Ruhua won't arrive until tomorrow, and the specific time is uncertain.
And by preparing the teleportation array tomorrow, you are completely prepared and can catch up.
"Okay, I'll make arrangements right away."
After Wen Xingxuan dropped a word, he disconnected.
Chen Wen's lips curled up slightly, he really did have an acquaintance who could help him.
It is undeniable that Wen string music helped him a lot.
After doing all this, Chen Wen didn't waste any time and immediately entered the state of cultivation.
One day passed in the blink of an eye.
Chen Wen woke up from his practice and immediately let out a breath of turbid air.
For one day outside, there are eight days in eternal space.
He only has eight days left to condense the seeds of his will.
